summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K on June 15, 2026, furnishing a press release dated June 10, 2026 that reports first quarter 2026 financial results and provides a corporate update. The update describes the completed acquisition of Recipharm Israel to expand its CDMO platform, non-dilutive funding initiatives, and priority on a systemic IL-17 bispecific antibody lead program. However, the filing itself is a routine periodic report of financial results and business progress; it does not announce a new special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
